item: ZIP64 offsets are not regenerated on append, merge or deep copy
note: Sparse-file regressions at 0x100000064: original entry reads hello; append and merge become unreadable; deep-copy destination resolves to the original header. Serialization reuses stripped or stale ZIP64 extra data.

item: Rewriting Implode entries drops decoding flags
note: Existing implode.zip reads before rewriting. Append, merge and raw copy all lose compression-specific bits and fail to decode in independent tests.

item: Raw copy loses ZipCrypto encryption state
note: Untouched by_index_raw copy succeeds but encrypted() becomes false and reading fails checksum; the original decrypts to hello.

item: Raw copy accepts readers whose required bytes were consumed
note: Fresh decrypted AES reader copies successfully but output rejects its password. Reading one byte from an ordinary Deflate entry before copying also yields unreadable output. Untouched raw AES control passes; remaining-byte copy is not validated.

item: Raw copy discards file kind, comments and extra fields
note: Independent tests show a symlink becomes a regular file, custom 0xbeef extra data disappears, and a file comment becomes empty. SimpleFileOptions reconstruction omits this metadata.

item: finish_into_readable retains ZIP64 sentinel sizes
note: Five-byte Stored entry with large_file(true) reports both sizes as 4294967295; read returns 94 bytes including directory data, then Invalid checksum. Serializing and reopening reads hello correctly.

item: finish_into_readable retains AES wire compression marker
note: Direct returned archive rejects correct-password access with unsupported compression; finish followed by ZipArchive::new decrypts the same kind of entry successfully.

item: Unicode comment checksum uses decoded comment bytes
note: Valid CP437 café comment with Unicode extra-field CRC over original bytes fails opening with Could not find EOCD. ASCII control and Python fixture reads pass; source hashes decoded UTF-8 instead.

item: Oversized filenames panic and abort during cleanup
note: 65535-byte boundary succeeds; 65536-byte name panics at unchecked u16 conversion. Standalone ordinary writer cleanup triggers a second panic at types.rs:934 and terminates with SIGABRT. Input exceeds ZIP filename capacity.

item: Appending long CP437 comments aborts during cleanup
note: Valid archive with 40000 CP437 bytes opens, but append finish converts the expanded UTF-8 comment length with unwrap. Standalone process panics twice at types.rs:938 and dies with SIGABRT.

item: Stream record boundary handling loses metadata and rejects empty archives
note: Two-entry visitor returns success with two file callbacks and zero metadata callbacks; empty archive returns UnexpectedEof. Local parser consumes 30 bytes before recognizing central header; visitor suppresses metadata parse errors. Existing tests never require metadata callbacks.

item: SeekFrom::End uses entire archive end
note: Regression seeks End(-2) on Stored hello and reads lo at entry offset 3. SeekableTake computes length plus offset and translates to the entry start.

item: Extraction skips restoring directory permissions
note: Linux regression archives directory mode 0500 and extracts it as 0755. Directory branch continues before adding its mode to the restoration queue.

item: Seekable entry API returns encrypted payload bytes
note: Stored ZipCrypto hello requires a password through by_index, but by_name_seek succeeds and returns 17 encrypted bytes. The seek path only checks compression.

item: Path lookup cannot retrieve directory entries
note: Directory created with add_directory_from_path(dir/subdir/) is found by_name with trailing slash but by_path of the same path returns FileNotFound; path normalization removes the slash.

item: Streamed data_start accessor panics
note: Ordinary streamed entry panics on data_start(): OnceLock is unset and accessor unwraps it, despite streaming documentation promising zero.

item: Stream raw copies omit required data descriptors
note: Raw-copy stream output sets bit 3 but contains no data descriptor; regular streamed-file control emits one. Central-directory reads still work. writing_raw skips descriptor finalization.

item: Stream directory entries omit required data descriptors
note: Stream directory output sets bit 3 and emits no descriptor. add_directory clears writing_to_file, bypassing finish_file descriptor writing.

item: Access-only extended timestamps become modification timestamps
note: Valid local field flags=2, length=5, timestamp=42 produces mod_time=Some(42), ac_time=None. The unconditional five-byte heuristic overrides the timestamp flags.

item: Documented Bzip2 default disagrees with actual default
note: With no default features and only bzip2 enabled, an ordinary default-options entry is Stored. Source documentation explicitly promises Bzip2 in this configuration.

item: Strict Clippy reports collapsible_match
note: Reproduced on Rust 1.99.1. Allowing this single lint makes strict all-feature/all-target Clippy pass; this is lint cleanliness, not a behavior defect.

item: Rustdoc contains unresolved links
note: Strict rustdoc reproduces five broken links with private items and six without default features; public all-feature sources account for four. Link qualification and conditional imports are documentation housekeeping.

item: Empty XZ entries contain invalid compressed data
note: Independent ordinary API round-trip of an empty XZ entry fails with index CRC32 mismatch under locked lzma-rust2 0.13.0. Nonempty XZ control reads correctly.

item: Streaming ZipCrypto uses wrong password verification byte
note: Fixed-timestamp streamed Stored hello finishes successfully, then rejects the correct password. Writer uses CRC byte; descriptor-flagged reader expects modification-time byte. Unstable API output is unreadable.

item: Zopfli-only low compression levels panic
note: With only deflate-zopfli, levels 1, 6 and 8 panic on subtraction, and 9 on zero NonZeroU64 conversion. Levels 0/265 return errors and 10/264 succeed. Range validation admits values below documented Zopfli minimum.

item: Append rewrites CP437 file comments with wrong encoding flag
note: Independent fixture comment café reads correctly before append and becomes caf├⌐ afterward. Writer emits UTF-8 comment bytes while flags are derived only from the ASCII filename.

item: ZIP64 comments disappear on small archives
note: set_zip64_comment(Some(hello)) on a small archive reopens with None. ZIP64 footer is emitted, but ZIP32 fields lack the sentinels required by reader detection.

item: Central-directory I/O failures lose their original error
note: Injected one I/O error specifically during the 46-byte central-header parse; constructor returned InvalidArchive(Could not find EOCD), not ZipError::Io. Candidate backtracking discards the original error.

item: Append drops existing archive comments
note: Append regression preserves raw archive comment bytes 0x82,0xff after adding another entry. Constructor explicitly copies shared.comment and shared.zip64_comment into writer state.

item: Public failure contracts omit Errors sections
note: Representative Result-returning APIs omit formal Errors headings; this is missing API documentation. The reported advisory count does not establish additional behavior defects.

item: Public ZipFile, ZipFileSeek and StreamWriter lack Debug
note: Source confirms the three types have no Debug implementation. Diagnostic convenience and derive support are public-API style housekeeping.

item: Unsafe byte-casting sites lack local safety explanations
note: Pod documents representation requirements, while byte-casting blocks and packed integer implementations lack local justifications. No production undefined behavior is established; local comments are maintainability hygiene.

item: Lint suppressions lack structured reasons
note: Source contains allow attributes without reason arguments, including nearby explanatory comments. Preference for reason/expect is lint housekeeping; no stale harmful exception was demonstrated.

item: Raw copying a freshly opened ordinary ZipFile copies decompressed bytes
note: Fresh by_name Deflate entry raw-copies and renames successfully, then reads original plaintext. take_raw_reader unwraps decoder layers to the original compressed stream. Consumed-reader failures are assessed separately.

item: Duplicate filenames silently replace original entries
note: Second start_file with identical name returns Duplicate filename error and original hello remains readable. insert_file_data checks contains_key before insertion.

item: Advertised docs.rs configuration uses removed nightly feature
note: Advertised --cfg docsrs command on installed nightly-2026-10-01 fails with E0557: doc_auto_cfg was removed in 1.92. Ordinary documentation builds do not enable this obsolete feature.

item: Directory entries retain Deflated without a compressed stream
note: add_directory explicitly forces Stored and clears encryption. Regression supplying Deflated options reopens as Stored and reads zero bytes successfully.

item: Streaming large_file rejects valid large compressed sizes
note: data_descriptor_block returns None when large_file is true, then write_data_descriptor rejects compressed_size above u32::MAX even in that ZIP64 branch. Thus a Stored 4 GiB entry is rejected despite opting into ZIP64; no large workload run.

item: Streaming ZIP64 central extra fields retain zero size placeholders
note: start_entry serializes ZIP64 sizes as zero. Streaming finish writes descriptors but never updates that extra field; central serialization reuses it. Once a central size overflows ZIP32, reparsing replaces its sentinel with zero. No multi-gigabyte workload run.

item: Extraction rejects ordinary links within destination
note: Ordinary real/ directory, link -> real, link/file extraction fails with Invalid base path. Canonical absolute base is passed to simplified_components, which rejects RootDir; same path is used when encountering an existing extracted link.

item: Stale optional Unicode path checksum rejects primary filename
note: Archive with valid primary name a and stale optional Unicode name fails opening with Could not find EOCD; primary payload is readable by Python. Source propagates optional-field CRC failure instead of falling back to primary filename.

item: Append serializes AES central method as underlying method
note: No-op append changes final central-directory AES method from 99 to 0 while local method remains 99. Reparsed underlying method is serialized directly, violating AES wire representation.

item: Documented Deflate compression level zero is rejected
note: All-features regression receives UnsupportedArchive for Deflated level 0 despite documented 0..9 range. Validation starts at Compression::fast(), whose level is 1.

item: Non-UTF-8 regression test violates String UTF-8 invariant
note: write_non_utf8 passes invalid GB18030 and Shift-JIS byte sequences to String::from_utf8_unchecked, violating its precondition. Native or Miri success cannot validate that test; no production unsoundness inference is needed.
